name: Glimmer of Hope
description: The Glimmer of Hope was a starship that served in the navy of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Between 2 BBY and 4 ABY, Grand-engineer Lony Coleema was kidnapped by the IG-88 assassin droid IG-88 after providing information about the Galactic Empire to the Rebel Alliance. The droid brought them to the Holowan droid foundry on a planet to access their brain and acquire the information.
